artworks.title: Charles II as a Child
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with curly hair, facial features, and a garment with a lace collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame against a plain background. There are age marks and a tear along the edge of the paper. The letters "G G" appear below the portrait within the oval.

artworks.title: Sir Edward Dering
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up. He has long, curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He wears an elaborate outfit with a striped sleeve, detailed armor, and a patterned sash. Emblems of a horse and a shield with a cross and wings are beside him. The background is textured with an inscription and coat of arms below the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir Edward Dering
artworks.description: The image shows a man, turned to his left. He has long, curly hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is wearing armor with decorative details, striped sleeves, and a lace collar. A fabric sash is around his waist. In the background are emblematic symbols and a coat of arms. There is ornate script and a coat of arms in a circular medallion, with text detailing the man's identity and title, dated 1640.

artworks.title: Sir Edward Dering
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the chest upwards, facing slightly to the viewer's right. He has a pointed mustache and a small goatee, with curly, shoulder-length hair. The man wears period attire, including a dark doublet with a lace collar. The background is plain with an oval frame, and the surface has a textured, aged appearance. There is text in cursive script providing the man's identity as "Dns Edoardus Dering de Surenden-Dering Miles et Baronecetus," along with initials "G.G." in the bottom-left corner.

artworks.title: John Foxe
artworks.description: The image displays a half-length portrait of an older man facing forward. He has a long, pointed beard and mustache, with a wrinkled forehead and deep-set eyes. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a patterned texture, a garment with a fur collar, and detailed cuffs. The background consists of horizontal lines. Inscriptions above the man read "ANNO DO 1587 AETAT 70," and below, there is Latin text related to the individual.

artworks.title: John Goodwin
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his left, wearing a dark robe with a ruffled collar and a cap. The man has a beard and mustache, a stern expression, and holds a book against his chest. The background has text borders and inscriptions, including the name "IOHANNES GOODWIN". The page looks old with a browned hue and worn edges.

artworks.title: William Perkins
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in a frontal position. He has a beard and moustache, with neatly trimmed hair. He is dressed in historical attire with a high and elaborate ruff around his neck. A patterned garment is visible underneath. The portrait is framed within an oval border with inscriptions. The background has densely lined patterns typical of engravings. Below the portrait, there is a panel with text as a tribute to the individual.

artworks.title: John Pym
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to his right. He has a mustache, a chin-inscribing hairline, shoulder-length hair parted in the middle, and wears a high-collared shirt with a white collar over a dark tunic or robe. The background features a dense cross-hatching design. Below the image, there is text identifying the man as John Pym.

artworks.title: Lewis Roberts
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man from the chest up. He faces slightly to his left, with his body turned toward the viewer. The man has a distinguished facial appearance, with a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. His hair is wavy, shoulder-length, and parted at the center. He is dressed in what appears to be 16th-century attire, with a dark, elaborately textured garment and a large lace collar. A decorative pin or fastener is visible at his neckline. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background features a pattern design bordered by octagonal frames with text, including inscriptions and decorative elements. Above the portrait is the date "1596" and a heraldic emblem with a lion rampant. Below the portrait is a passage of stylized handwriting resembling a poem, providing further context about the effigy depicted.

artworks.title: Lewis Roberts
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to his right. The man has wavy shoulder-length hair and a well-groomed mustache and goatee. He is dressed in formal attire, featuring a dark doublet with intricate detailing and a large, decorative lace collar. The border of the engraving contains an inscription around the oval frame that identifies the subject. The background of the image consists of a fine, cross-hatched texture. No jewelry or objects are visible, and the overall setting is simple.

artworks.title: James Ussher, Archbishop of Armagh
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is positioned facing forward and slightly looking to his left. His facial features include a full beard and mustache, and he has bushy eyebrows. He is wearing a cap on his head, and his hair is not prominently visible. The man's attire is ornate, featuring a large, elaborate ruff collar, layered clothing with a detailed outer robe, and a patterned inner garment. He is not visibly holding any objects or wearing jewelry. The background of the image is a detailed, inscribed oval frame with text around it, and there is an illustration below the man's portrait within the frame. The entire image has a textured, engraved appearance with decorative elements surrounding the figure.

artworks.title: Edward VI
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a young person from the chest up. The individual faces forward with their head slightly turned towards the viewer. They have an oval-shaped face, almond-shaped eyes, and styled hair covered by a dark flat hat with a white feather. The person wears an elaborate garment with a high fur collar and detailed patterns, possibly embroideries, including horizontal bands across the chest. There is no visible jewelry, and the background is plain and light. Below the portrait, there is calligraphic script, likely inscribing a name and title.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a woman centered within an outlined oval. Her pose is upright and frontal with her face looking directly at the viewer. She has a composed facial expression with sharp features. Her hair is styled intricately, pulled back from the forehead and decorated with a headdress featuring pearls and decorative elements. The woman is dressed in a detailed gown with an elaborate collar, opulent patterns, ruffles, and embroidery. She wears a necklace that matches the ornate nature of her clothing. The background is plain, emphasizing her attire and jewelry. Below the illustration is text identifying her as "Elizabetha D G Regina, Ang Fran et Hib," and "sould by Robt Peak."

artworks.title: Title Page for Devotionis Augustinianae Flamma, by William Austin
artworks.description: The image is an intricate illustration with various scenes and figures in a grid layout. In the center is a portrait of a man, likely William Austin, wearing Elizabethan-style clothing. Above and below the central text are framed scenes depicting religious or meditative themes with figures engaged in activities like prayer, worship, and angelic conflict. Some scenes show groups of people in biblical attire in spiritual settings, with one scene depicting an angel battling a dragon-like creature. The background features skies and clouds. Decorative elements like scrollwork and cartouches frame each scene.

artworks.title: Title Page for Devotionis Augustinianae Flamma, by William Austin
artworks.description: This is a multi-paneled etching featuring religious themes. The central panel shows a man in traditional attire. Surrounding panels depict figures in biblical or religious scenes. The scenes vary in setting and posture, with figures engaged in different activities. The etching includes intricate details, like facial expressions and symbols, enhancing its religious narrative.

artworks.title: Title Page for The Golden Scepter, by John Preston
artworks.description: This is a detailed engraving of the title page of a book titled "The Golden Scepter." The central rectangular area features the title of the book, "THE GOLDEN SCEPTER. with The Churches Marriage; And THE CHURCHES CARRIAGE. In three Treatises, BY The late Learned Divine, John Preston." Surrounding the central text are various intricate engravings. In the top left corner, one scene shows a kneeling individual receiving a scepter from an enthroned figure, accompanied by the text, "Then was I in his eyes as one that found favor." To the right, another scene depicts a king and a woman with the text, "I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine." Below, on the left, a group of figures is shown, with some appearing empathetic, and the words, "They have humbled themselves, therefore I will not destroy them." In the bottom right corner, an individual is depicted bending over a book, illuminated by a divine light, alongside the phrase, "When thou goest, it shall lead thee." The style is reminiscent of the detailed woodcut or metal engraving techniques from the 17th century, with intricate shading and texture created using hatching and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Charles II as Prince
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a person from the chest up, facing slightly to their left. The individual, referred to as a prince, has long, curly hair reaching past the shoulders. They have an oval-shaped face with prominent features, including a pronounced nose and lips. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat with a large feather and a detailed jacket with light and dark vertical stripes. They have a high-collared lace shirt with a prominent lace edge. The figure is enclosed within an oval frame with surrounding text and a finely hatched background. The bottom of the image features a decorative border with text. The style resembles a classical engraving technique.

artworks.title: Algeron Percy, 10th Earl of Northumberland
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person depicted from the waist up, positioned with their body slightly turned to the side while their head faces forward, looking directly at the viewer. The person has distinctive facial features with pronounced eyebrows, a well-groomed mustache, and long wavy hair that falls over the shoulders. They are dressed in a dark garment with a detailed, ruffled white collar. The person is encased within an ornate oval frame that bears inscriptions and decorative elements. Around this frame are additional embellishments, including the figure of a bearded man holding a trident and a seated figure of a woman. In the background, several ships sail on the sea under a cloud-filled sky.

artworks.title: Josuah Sylvester, Poet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up within an ornate oval frame. The man is positioned facing forward with his head slightly turned to his side, sporting well-defined facial features—a high forehead, strong brows, and a neatly trimmed beard and mustache. His hair is short and styled, adorned with a laurel wreath that encircles his head. He wears an elaborate ruffled collar and a richly detailed garment with intricate stitching and puffed sleeves. The background has a dense pattern, and around the oval frame is a decorative border with Latin text. Below the portrait are verses honoring the person's accomplishments and character, along with the name 'John Sturart' inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Title Page to Cruso, Militarie Instructions for the Cavallrie
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military scene featuring cavalry. The central focus is a large frame with the title "MILITARIE INSTRUCTIONS for the CAVALLRIE: According to the Moderne Warrs" in decorative script. Surrounding the title, cavalrymen on horseback are depicted in different formations or scenarios. Atop the frame is a decorative coat of arms with helmets, plumes, and military symbols. In the background, a view of a city or fortress is visible. The lower section shows a skirmish between two mounted soldiers, one holding a gun and the other a lance. The composition is detailed, emphasizing military instruction and cavalry maneuvers.

artworks.title: Patrick Forbes, Bishop of Aberdeen
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right, gazing directly out of the frame. The man has facial hair and a neutral expression with gently arched eyebrows. His hair is neatly styled and he wears a decorated collared garment, possibly a ruff. The circular frame around the portrait has inscribed text and the background features fine, engraved lines. Below the portrait, there is more inscribed text. The overall style of the image suggests it is an engraving.

artworks.title: Richard Gethinge, Writing Master
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper part of a man's body within an ornate oval frame, labeled "RICHARDUS GETHING HERTFORDIENSIS ÆT. 32." The man is looking slightly to the left, showing his right profile. He has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly closely cropped hair, and wears a detailed garment with a high collar and ruffles, as well as a buttoned jacket. To the right of the frame is an artistic representation of a hand holding a quill, suggesting writing or calligraphy. The background features calligraphic flourishes and text.

artworks.title: John Bate, Writer
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing forward with his head turned slightly to the right. The man has a wide nose, a short mustache, and his eyes are looking at the viewer. His hair is styled in a short wavy fringe and he is dressed in historical attire with a high collar and padded sleeves. The background features an oval frame with a cross-hatched pattern and below the oval, there is text that reads "Vera Effiges Johannis Bate: Memoria manet, modo permaneat Studium et industria."

artworks.title: John Bate
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, focusing on his head and shoulders. The man is facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has a mustache and short, curly hair. He is wearing a garment with a wide, stiff collar that is buttoned down in the front. The background of the portrait includes a finely lined oval frame. Text in elegant script is at the bottom of the image. There are no visible objects or jewelry.
